reason: The established mental-misdeed compound brnab sems owns Coveting, the first named member of the mental trio.

sogs is the enumerative closing gesture, owning and the rest at d6. Rest alone at d5 misclassifies the function and drops part of its explicit English realization. Three misdeeds remains outside this particle span.
yid owns thought as the mental domain of the first three misdeeds; the explanatory misdeeds head is not sourced by this noun.
kyi marks the domain relation rendered of immediately before thought.
First gsum counts the three mental misdeeds. It is distinct from the two later three-roots occurrences.
First rtsa ba owns the first roots, introducing the origins of the mental misdeeds; of non-virtue is an explanatory qualification.
Second gsum counts the first three roots; the later numeral belongs to their explicit restatement.
First las is from after the first come, for the mental misdeeds arising from their roots.
First skyes owns the first come predicated of the mental misdeeds, not the later virtues.
Second rtsa ba owns roots in them--to these three roots, the explicit restatement of the referent.
Take gsum alone for the third three occurrence. Nominal po stays unwrapped; it supplies no separate numeral meaning.
The whole demonstrative de'i owns them, referring to the already named three roots. The genitive participates in the temporal construction; no separate 'i exponent or unsupported null is asserted.

The complete mjug thogs expression owns just subsequent: thogs contributes immediate adjacency, so just is part of the temporal meaning, not a supplied participant. The full HGM record has subsequent and the reference comparanda clarify immediacy without becoming GMR wording.
The middle las participates in the temporal after/succession construction, locally recast as to after subsequent. The following root restatement repeats to but has no second source las.
byung ba is occur in the reason clause about the mental misdeeds; the English they is supplied.
phyir gives because, expressing the reason for the preceding statement without taking its supplied subject.
dge ba denotes virtues in this karma commentary. The HGM glossary virtues is relevant here; curated prayer-register goodness remains intact and is not overwritten.
bcu counts the ten virtues, not the three stages or the three roots.
sbyor ba owns undertaking in the actual parenthesized stages list, with the whole technical unit retained.
First stage-list dang owns and between undertaking and conclusion, not the earlier explanatory and here we consider.
mjug owns conclusion as a named stage, distinct from the earlier mjug thogs temporal compound.
Second stage-list dang owns as well as before actual commission, the second list coordinator.
The complete technical dngos gzhi compound owns actual commission at d5. This does not authorize a new standalone gzhi/commission pair.

The transparent dngos member owns actual within its unique dngos gzhi/actual commission parent at d7. One new exact read-only dngos query returned the complete HGM HTG2016 entry with actual, plus its full master glossary object. The reference comparanda remain distinct; no member for gzhi/commission is inferred.

Keep complete dang bcas pa/with at d3: the comitative construction attaches the enumerated stages to the virtues. It is not bare lexical bcas and not a standalone d6 particle. The later possessing belongs to the root-negation clause and is not borrowed.
chags owns desire as the first lexical stem under the single shared med. This does not assert that the virtues arise from positive desire; shared negative scope is recorded separately.
sdang owns dislike as the second stem under shared med; no dislike is not invented as a separate Tibetan compound.
gti mug owns ignorance as the third stem under the same med; negation is not restricted to this nearest stem.

The single med has semantic scope over all three root names and is rendered three times as no. Bank it once at first no, the start of the English negative list; leave the other two no occurrences unbanked repetitions. This representative pair does not exhaust or narrow the shared scope and is not a null.
Final las owns from after the second come, for the virtues arising from absence of the three afflictive roots.
Final skyes pa owns the second come, whose subject is the ten virtues together with their stages.
